garden is way down below Sevind
Palace Plaza.

rows.label: tlk43200144_05_msg0002

how I'd like to go one day!

rows.label: tlk43200144_05_msg0003

But I've never seen Her Majesty jump
to the Perla Fountain Park Ruins.
I wonder how she gets there?

rows.label: tlk43200144_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Oh! Maybe there's a secret
passage that only the six
noble houses can use!
